scope: Additional boundary case beyond the prescribed fixtures and pinned public descriptions

diagnostics.message: string contains an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate

decision: Reject unpaired UTF-16 surrogates with the existing SDK InvalidInput convention. analyzeOpenApi returns an incomplete report; compileOpenApi throws OpenApiInvalid with the report diagnostics; CLI exits 2 and attaches the source location.
scanPolicy: The JavaScript fallback scans only after the MoonBit JSON parser returns InvalidJson. Input is neither deleted nor replaced.
coverage: object and JSON text entry points
valid surrogate pair, Chinese text and literal backslash-u text
SDK and CLI report shape, source location and exit code
